baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exclusive construction وما ... إلا كل and the linked predicates معتد أثيم.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse does more than pair denial with a bad label: totality gathers a complete behavioral type in which crossing a rightful bound and lagging from good coexist, making denial the diagnostic expression of that disposition.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a thing or bearer false supplies the explicit denial operation anchored in يكذب.
Totality and completeness make كل gather the whole denier-type rather than name an isolated lapse.
Overstepping a bound into injustice gives معتد its boundary-crossing component.
Slowing and lagging from good makes أثيم a directional failure, not merely a static moral badge.

changed_reading.before: Only a sinful transgressor denies it.
changed_reading.after: Denial is profiled as the recognizable output of a whole disposition: comprehensive boundary-overstepping joined to persistent lagging from good.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The attribution verb يكذب and the returned epithets معتد أثيم.
baseline_models.mechanism: The denier directs a judgment of falsity outward, while the verse directs a complete counter-classification inward: the one who charges the referent with falsehood is charged with transgression and sin. The syntax therefore performs a reversal of attribution as well as describing one.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood supplies the outward charge made by the denier.
Complete inclusion makes the counter-classification cover every member introduced after إلا.
Boundary-overstepping identifies the returned charge as a judgment about the denier's conduct.
Charging or loading sin onto someone supplies the inward counter-attribution carried by أثيم.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports that morally bad people reject a proposition.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a contested judgment: their outward declaration of falsity is answered by a totalizing attribution of boundary-crossing and incurred sin back onto them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The motion-bearing branch images available under يكذب, معتد, and أثيم.
baseline_models.mechanism: A kinetic micro-model coexists with the moral reading: one hastens beyond the proper boundary, then stalls, looks back, or lags when movement toward good is required. Denial becomes interrupted moral motion rather than a motionless opinion.

activation_trace.role: The wild animal running and then stopping supplies the abrupt stall within the denial image.
Weariness and loss of sharpness reinforce the image of motion or perception going dull.
Running and hastening give the transgressor the forward rush that exceeds the limit.
Lagging from good supplies the opposed delay that completes the stop-and-rush pattern.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a settled negative opinion.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, denial is a broken trajectory: haste carries the person past limits while dullness and delay stop movement toward good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening exchange pattern turns denial into epistemic short-measure: the same agent who demands completion for the self but causes loss when measuring others also grants full weight to self-interest while discounting the claim carried by به. Boundary transgression is thus calibrated asymmetry, not undirected excess.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the referent false anchors the revised model in the focus denial.
Overstepping a rightful bound lets the measuring asymmetry specify what kind of transgression معتد performs.
Measuring one matter against another supplies the comparison frame that can be skewed between self and other.
Completion without deficiency supplies the full amount demanded on the receiving side.
The balance of justice supplies the norm against which the denial is read as biased calibration.
Causing loss in measure supplies the outward shortfall mirrored by discounting what is denied.

structural_cues: 83:1's branchless ط ف ف label structurally opens the measuring sequence but is not assigned an invented branch.
83:2-3 reverse the direction of benefit between receiving from people and measuring out to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comparison, full completion, just balance, and induced shortfall; I infer an arrow from commercial asymmetry to asymmetric evaluation of the denied claim. A live alternative is that trade fraud and denial are parallel symptoms of one disposition rather than one modeling the other.

changed_reading.before: معتد names a generally excessive person who happens to deny.
changed_reading.after: The denier crosses the limit by using two standards: full measure for the self, short measure for others and for the truth-claim that would bind the self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denied referent becomes an approaching activation and reckoning: signs can yield warranted certainty, what is still will be stirred, people will stand, and account will be rendered. Joined to أثيم as lagging, denial reads as attempted temporal deferral of an event that will not remain deferred.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the referent false anchors the attempted cancellation of the coming event.
Lagging from good supplies the focus verse's temporal resistance to accountability.
Certainty after an indicator makes the issue one of warranted recognition rather than evidence-free conjecture.
Stirring what is still from rest supplies the activation the denier tries to hold at a distance.
Resurrection and the standing of the Hour turn activation into compulsory public standing.
Accounting and recompense identify what the coming standing is for.

structural_cues: 83:4-6 moves from expectation, through being raised, to collective standing.
83:11 supplies the explicit object يوم الدين immediately before the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warranted expectation, activation from stillness, standing, and account; I infer that denial functions as a strategy of postponement and that lagging in أثيم is its temporal signature. An alternative is simple disbelief with no motivated deferral mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The denier rejects an abstract future doctrine.
changed_reading.after: The denier tries to defer a process already moving from sign to activation to standing to account; أثيم names the lag that cannot stop that sequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Spoken deauthorization confronts an order that is written, binding, registered, and visibly marked. The paired records on both sides make denial ineffective as erasure: the utterance that calls the matter false becomes conduct that remains classifiable and recordable.

activation_trace.role: Declaring something false supplies the attempted verbal deauthorization opposed by the record.
Charging or loading sin supplies the entry-like burden returned to the one making the denial.
Writing that establishes a binding judgment supplies the record's authority against verbal cancellation.
A marked line in a book or register supplies durable legibility to the binding record.
Entering a name in a register supplies personal classification on the contrasting record.
The repeated marked-register image makes the recording structure symmetrical across the two outcomes.

structural_cues: The identical normalized phrase كتب مرقوم appears at 83:9 and 83:20 around the focus region.
The lower and upper records classify opposed groups without making the focus verse choose only one local branch image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding inscription, registration, and repeated marked records; I infer that denial attempts an erasure which the record structurally defeats, and that denial itself becomes recordable. A live alternative is that the records contain outcomes only, with no direct inscription of the denial act.

changed_reading.before: Denial can be imagined as a private assertion against an unseen claim.
changed_reading.after: Denial is a futile bid to deauthorize what is already bindingly legible, and the bid itself enters the classification it tries to erase.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial acquires a material history: acquired acts form a coating or trapped condition, that condition blocks access, and later covering language names the resulting party. What looks like a single proposition-level rejection is the visible surface of accumulated obstruction.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the referent false anchors the materialized process in the focus act of denial.
A patterned cloth that deceives by its condition supplies an outward surface whose appearance can misreport what lies beneath.
A condition of being caught with no exit supplies the enclosing accretion on the heart.
Seeking and acquiring gain supplies the repeated human inputs from which the obstruction accumulates.
A screening barrier supplies the reciprocal blocked access that follows the inner obstruction.
Obscuring truth supplies the later group-name's covering operation and closes the material model.

structural_cues: 83:14 corrects the preceding speech formula with بل and places acquired conduct on the heart before 83:15 names blocked access.
The later group label at 83:34 and 83:36 repeats after the coating-and-barrier sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquisition, an inescapable coating-like state, a barrier, and obscuring; I infer the causal arrow acquired acts -> inner accretion -> denial -> reciprocal exclusion. Alternatives remain live: the heart-state may directly cause denial without a staged buildup, and the later barrier may be consequence rather than mirror.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a discrete utterance caused by a pre-existing bad character.
changed_reading.after: Denial is the exposed surface of conduct accumulated into an inner obstruction, followed by an answering obstruction to access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later speakers do not merely disagree; they pronounce others astray while lacking any commission to guard them. That sequence specifies معتد as jurisdictional crossing: denial is an unauthorized verdict that occupies a role the speakers were not sent to hold.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood supplies the focus verse's act of passing judgment on a claim.
Crossing a bound into injustice lets the later lack of commission define the violated jurisdiction.
Imposing a judgment on another supplies the mechanics of the speakers' verdict.
Deviation from guidance supplies the exact classification imposed on the believers.
Messenger and commission supply the authorization that the judging speakers lack.
Guarding and oversight supply the institutional role explicitly denied to them.

structural_cues: 83:32's quoted verdict is immediately followed by 83:33's denial of a guarding commission.
The construction وما ... إلا in 83:12 and وما ... حافظين in 83:33 echo through two exclusions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a verdict of error followed by explicit absence of guarding commission; I infer that the verdict crosses a jurisdictional boundary and illuminates معتد. A live alternative is that 83:33 only rebukes surveillance, while the transgression in 83:12 remains broader.

changed_reading.before: The transgressor privately refuses a truth-claim.
changed_reading.after: The transgressor usurps authority: denial becomes an uncommissioned verdict over truth and over other people, not merely private non-assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet's minority mapping from focus ع د و to ع د د becomes audible inside a sequence of weighing and registration. Without replacing معتد's dominant transgression sense, it overlays the boundary-crosser with the one being enumerated and entered into an account: every such person is not only excessive but countable.

activation_trace.role: The split-root image of enumerating a counted thing supplies the exploratory audit echo inside معتد.
Totality makes كل gather every member into the count rather than leave the echo indefinite.
Estimating by weight supplies the first formal quantification in the surrounding sequence.
Entering a name in a register turns quantification into classified membership.
A marked register supplies the durable count into which the transgressor can be entered.

structural_cues: Measurement at 83:2-3 develops into the repeated record formulas at 83:7-9 and 83:18-20.
The split mapping is retained as packet-supplied activation material, not collapsed into the dominant ع د و target.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a non-dominant ع د د mapping plus weighing and registers; I infer an associative overlay from transgressor to counted subject. The materially live alternative is that this mapping is only formal noise and should never affect translation of معتد.

changed_reading.before: كل معتد only universalizes a class of people who exceed limits.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the universal class is also an audit population: each boundary-crosser is countable, classifiable, and unable to remain outside the marked account.

context_deltas.mechanism: A second minority mapping from focus ع د و to ع و د joins the repeated laughter, doubled turning-back, and final return of recompense. It renders transgression as a habituated loop whose social action reverses direction and comes back to its actor.

activation_trace.role: Habit and repeated engagement supply the exploratory recurrence inside the focus transgressor.
Turning a thing away from its face supplies the doubled reversal enacted in the verse.
Joy or wonder appearing as laughter supplies the first-direction social act.
The repeated laughter image with exchanged subjects supplies the reversal of direction.
Recompense returning to its worker makes the repeated conduct loop back as consequence.

structural_cues: 83:31 repeats انقلبوا within one ayah, making return formally conspicuous.
83:29 and 83:34 repeat laughter with the two groups exchanging subject and object positions before 83:36 asks about returned recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence, reversal, and recompense returning to the worker; I infer that the non-dominant ع و د mapping lets معتد carry a habit-and-return undertone. The alternative is to confine all return imagery to the later social reversal and leave the focus participle untouched.

changed_reading.before: معتد describes a one-directional act of crossing a limit.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the crossing is a repeated habit in a return circuit: the judgment and laughter sent outward reverse and come back as recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: A deceptive surface in the focus denial is countered by marks that remain readable and by a condition recognized on faces. The context changes denial from speech alone into attempted surface-management: covering or patterned appearance cannot prevent the eventual state from becoming publicly legible.

activation_trace.role: A patterned cloth whose condition deceives supplies the focus anchor for manipulated appearance.
Visible patterning and inscription supply a mark that can be read rather than a surface that successfully deceives.
Recognition after an effect or sign supplies the act of reading an embodied condition.
The face and presented front supply the public surface on which the condition is read.
Radiant freshness supplies the visible state that defeats concealment through unmistakable appearance.
Covering supplies the opposing attempt to keep truth or condition beneath a surface.

structural_cues: The marked records precede 83:24's explicit recognition on faces.
The final section repeatedly makes looking, faces, laughter, and group labels public rather than private.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive pattern, visible inscription, recognition by signs, face, radiance, and covering; I infer a movement from managed appearance to unavoidable legibility. A live alternative is that record marks and facial radiance remain separate scenes with no shared surface mechanism.

changed_reading.before: يكذب is only a verbal rejection of content.
changed_reading.after: Denial also tries to manage what appears true, but the surrounding sequence makes moral condition durable in marks and finally readable on public surfaces.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form أثيم ordinarily functions as a sinner epithet while its branch inventory only reports, with uncertainty, a wine-name usage. It remains anchored in the explicit focus root and becomes active beside the later selected pure drink; downstream prose must present it as a contrastive root echo, never as a replacement gloss for أثيم.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The rare wine-name branch under focus أثيم, held beside the later drinking sequence.

activation_trace.role: The reported naming of wine as ithm supplies the form-distant focus echo without changing the adjective's ordinary syntax.
Pure selected wine supplies the later positive drink against which the focus echo becomes contrastive.
A secure preventing seal supplies preservation and controlled access for the contrasted drink.
Taking in liquid makes the positive drinking scene explicit rather than merely nominal.

changed_reading.before: أثيم contributes only a general intensification of sinfulness.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root echo, the sinner epithet shadows a compromised drink-domain that the later pure, sealed drink reverses; moral orientation changes the scene of ingestion without changing the lexical gloss.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because كل is plainly the universal quantifier here, while crown, surrounding ring, barrier, seal, and covering are branch-level cross-domain images. It remains anchored in the focus كل inventory and gains repeated enclosure support in context; downstream prose should call it a spatial overlay on totality, not a syntactic reanalysis.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كل at word 5 as totality with a dormant surrounding-ring image.

activation_trace.role: A crown or surrounding ring gives the universal class an exploratory spatial boundary.
A screening barrier supplies the later enclosure that blocks passage across the class boundary.
A secure seal supplies a second bounded-container image elsewhere in the sequence.
A covering crown repeats both enclosure and crown imagery at the later group label.

changed_reading.before: كل merely quantifies all members of the denier class.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, totality also draws a ring around the class: the limit-crosser is paradoxically enclosed by a classification whose later barriers, seals, and coverings he cannot cross.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the appeal-for-redress branch belongs to the focus ع د و inventory but is not the direct participial sense of معتد. It remains valid as an activated legal consequence of aggression when standing, account, and witness appear; downstream prose should render it as the counterclaim generated by transgression, not translate معتد as a claimant.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: معتد at word 6, whose root inventory includes both aggression and an appeal against a wrongdoer.

activation_trace.role: Appeal to a ruler or judge for redress supplies the latent counterclaim produced by the focus transgression.
Resurrection and standing of the Hour supply the forum in which the counterclaim can come due.
Accounting and recompense supply the adjudicative operation applied to the wrong.
Presence with witnessing supplies an evidentiary audience for the recorded distinction.

changed_reading.before: معتد only marks the offender's initiative in crossing a boundary.
changed_reading.after: The same aggression also generates its opposite vector: a claim for redress that will stand, be witnessed, and be accounted even while the aggressor denies it.

strongest_changes: The measuring prelude makes denial an asymmetric act of valuation: full measure for the self and short measure for binding truth and other people.
Raising, standing, and account turn denial into attempted temporal deferral rather than a merely abstract doctrinal mistake.
Repeated binding records make denial a failed erasure whose own act remains classifiable and legible.
The later verdict over supposedly astray believers exposes معتد as unauthorized jurisdiction, not only undirected excess.
summary.what_was_special: The packet supported several coexisting mechanisms instead of one verdict: economic calibration, delayed activation, durable inscription, accumulated occlusion, and usurped judgment. Most unusually, the split ع د و mappings remained live as contained counting and return circuits, while rare focus branches opened kinetic, drink, enclosure, and redress readings without being promoted into replacement glosses.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact scope of the pronoun in به remains recoverable from context at more than one scale: Day of Account, the announced record-order, or the broader signs.
The causal direction between repeated transgression, heart-occlusion, and denial remains abductive; the packet also permits them as mutually reinforcing symptoms.
The non-dominant ع د د and ع و د mappings may encode productive latent echoes or only formal mapping distance, so both are retained as exploratory.
The wine-name and surrounding-ring activations are branch-backed but form-distant and require explicit qualification in any downstream rendering.
